title: Rainfall & Blossoms

outfit_card.silhouette: High-waisted corset bodice with an off-shoulder ruffled neckline, a voluminous bell-shaped skirt and a cascading waterfall bustle; asymmetric petal-cut cape drapes over one shoulder.
outfit_card.headpiece_and_hair_ornaments: Oversized wide-brimmed hat draped with sheer dotted tulle, clustered pearl strands, and sculpted white and green blossoms with gilded bell-shaped pendants.
outfit_card.upper_garment_and_sleeves: Boned corset with a pale pearlescent diamond-lattice overlay, off-shoulder ruffles edged in pearl drop tassels, puffed tulle sleeves with scalloped lace cuffs and a bow at centre bust.
outfit_card.lower_garment_and_legwear: Full gathered skirt with sheer organza overlay and pearl-tipped lace hem, layered over petticoat tiers; floral vine embroidery clings above white lace stockings and pearl-buckled slippers.
outfit_card.signature_props_and_motifs: Iridescent dewdrop beads floating around the wrists, a rain-streaked petal umbrella, and loose lily-of-the-valley sashes trailing from the bustle.
